description: List HelloBooks done-for-you services — sold separately from the software plans in list_plans. Fixed-price monthly bookkeeping plans (Starter / Standard / Plus / VIP) in the US, UK, Canada, UAE, New Zealand and Australia; US tax-return preparation (from $299 salary-only 1040, from $999 for other returns) and UK Self Assessment / CT600 packages with MTD VAT and payroll add-ons; UAE VAT and corporate-tax packages; and dedicated CPA-firm staffing (US, UK, CA). New Zealand and Australia are bookkeeping-only; India is not served. Call with no args for a per-market overview, or with `market` and/or `service` (bookkeeping | tax | staffing) for full plans, inclusions and prices. Use this when a user asks about hiring HelloBooks to do their bookkeeping, tax return, VAT or corporate tax filing, or staff a CPA firm.

market.description: Service market: US, UK (United Kingdom), CA, AE (UAE), NZ or AU. Services are not offered in India or other countries.

service.description: bookkeeping = fixed monthly bookkeeping plans; tax = tax-return / VAT / corporate-tax packages; staffing = dedicated CPA-firm staffing (US, UK, CA).
